home.heroSubheadline: Walaalnimo dhismeed ah oo haween Muslimah ah oo ka socota Waqooyiga Galbeed ee Baasifika — isu taageera, isu qaada, oo beesha isku xidha.
home.missionText: Waxaan nahay hay'ad dadweyne ah oo kooban walaalaha Portland, Oregon iyo Washington, oo u adeegta walaalaha ku nool Waqooyiga Galbeed ee Baasifika.
home.pillar1Desc: Socdaalo, isu imaatinno, dib u nasasho, iyo xirfadaha noolaha — walaalnimada loo dhiso waayo aragnimada wadaaga.
home.pillar2Desc: Xoojinta dhaqanka u gaar ah iyo taageerada haweenka Muslimah ee xaaladaha adag.
home.pillar3Desc: Shabakad, talooyinka, iyo tilmaanta kheyraadka bulshada ee la aaminsan.
home.hwrapSectionDesc: Haddaad adiga ama qof aad garanayso taageero u baahan tahay, waxaan halkan joognaa.
home.hwrapCrisis: Khatar degdeg ah? 911 Wac. Khadka Qaranka ee Rabshadaha Guriga: 1-800-799-7233.
home.donationBannerText: Taageeradaadu waxay nagu siin doontaa inaan ujeedadayada sii wadno. Muslimahs United waa hay'ad aan faa'iido doon ahayn 501(c)(3) — dhammaan deeqaha waa ka-jarida cashuurta.

about.title: Naga
about.storyText: Muslimahs United waa hay'ad gaar ah oo ka soo baxday baahida haweenka Muslimah ee midabka leh si ay ula xiriireen walaalnimo, goob aan xukunayn halka walaalaha Muslimah ee dhammaan asalka ah ay ku soo dhoweyn.
about.approachText: Mid ka mid ah ujeedadayadu waa in la abuuro deegaan caafimaad leh oo dhammaystiran. Tani waxaan ku gaadhnaa by abaabulidda xaddiga ballaadhan ee dhacdooyinka iyo adeegyada gaar ah.

programs.title: Barnaamijyadayada
programs.intro: Barnaamijyadayadu waxay ku xidhan yihiin baahida bulshadeena — taageero toos ah kuwa xaaladda adag ku jira, iyo howlaha dhismaha bulshada.
programs.hwrapTitle: HWRAP — Mashruuca Hidaya ee Kheyraadka iyo Xoojinta Haweenka
programs.hwrapDesc: Talooyin xaaladaha deg-deg ah, xoojin, iyo taageero haweenka Muslimah ee kulmay rabshadaha guriga.
programs.comingSoonDesc: Muslimahs United waxay koraysa. Barnaamijyo cusub ayaa la horumarinayaa — dib u soo noqo ama nala soo xiriir.

activities.title: Howlaha Bulshada
activities.intro: Ujeedadayadu waa inaan howlaha bishiiba abaabulno. Waxaan bixinaa socdaalo, dib u nasasho, isu imaatinno, iyo howlaha kale ee dhismaha bulshada. Dhammaan haweenka Muslimah waa soo dhaweeyeen.
activities.noEvents: Dib u soo noqo dhacdooyinka soo socda.
activities.loadError: Dhacdooyinka hadda lama soo qaadi karo. Fadlan dib u soo noqo ama nala soo xiriir.
